blocks.text: Quoted from the English Wikipedia, «Russian grammar» § Word formation (CC BY-SA 4.0).

This course takes the commonest prefixes, suffixes and roots one at a time. For each, the lesson quotes what the English Wiktionary says it means, then lists the common words Wiktionary builds with it, each with Wiktionary's own account of how it is made and what it means. The practice uses real sentences from Tatoeba with their English.
